application.letter:
Dear Evercore Recruiting Team,

I am a first-year Finance and Business Information Systems major in the John V. Roach Honors College at Texas Christian University, pursuing a Fintech Certification and planning to graduate in May 2029. I am writing to apply for the 2028 Strategic Advisory: M&A Summer Analyst Program. With a 3.8 GPA, leadership roles across campus, and hands-on exposure to valuation and M&A concepts, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to and learn from Evercore’s strategic advisory franchise.

Through the J.P. Morgan Investment Banking Virtual Experience Program, I built a DCF model and a comparable company analysis in Excel to evaluate M&A acquisition scenarios and then synthesized the outputs into a client pitch deck with strategic acquisition recommendations. I also conducted market research across valuation, deal screening, and pitch preparation workflows. These experiences have given me an early understanding of how rigorous quantitative analysis and clear communication support high-impact strategic decisions for clients.

On campus, I oversee the budget for TCU’s NABA chapter, managing SGA funding allocations and corporate sponsorship packages while performing financial planning and variance analysis. As President and Founder of the UNO Club, and as Director of Travel & Experience for TCU Alternative Break – Service Board, I lead teams, manage logistics, and coordinate initiatives that require organization, accountability, and the ability to work with diverse groups. Additionally, my work-study role supporting faculty and staff in the College of Education has strengthened my work ethic and attention to detail in a professional environment.

I would welcome the chance to bring my analytical background, leadership experiences, and enthusiasm for strategic advisory to Evercore while continuing to grow under your mentorship and training programs. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Dilandimel Desman
